title: Why Spain Stopped: The Housing Strike & Snap Election
description: A fast-paced explainer of Spain's historic general strike over the housing crisis, the political clashes ahead of the November 2026 snap election, and how a deadly train crash shifted everything.

seo.title: Why Spain Stopped Working Over Rent Crisis
seo.description: Spain just hit pause with its first general walkout in fourteen years as millions demand action on a housing crisis where rents have nearly doubled and evictions spark national outrage ahead of a critical snap election. From shuttered factories to parliamentary gridlock, discover why this historic strike is forcing the country's deepest political divide onto the ballot and whether street pressure can finally force emergency tenant protections before voters head to the polls.
